name: mFOLFOX6: Oxaliplatin + Leucovorin + 5-Fluorouracil (Small Bowel Adenocarcinoma)

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Small Bowel Adenocarcinoma v1.2026

histology: small bowel adenocarcinoma (duodenal, jejunal, or ileal)
supportiveCare: Cold avoidance for oxaliplatin acute neuropathy
monitoring: Sensory neuropathy assessment before each cycle

drugs.name: Oxaliplatin
drugs.notes: Oxaliplatin 85 mg/m2 IV in D5W over 2 hours on Day 1.

drugs.name: Leucovorin
drugs.notes: Leucovorin 400 mg/m2 IV over 2 hours concurrently with oxaliplatin on Day 1.

drugs.name: Fluorouracil (5-FU Bolus)
drugs.notes: 5-FU 400 mg/m2 IV bolus on Day 1 following leucovorin.

drugs.name: Fluorouracil (5-FU Continuous)
drugs.notes: 5-FU 2400 mg/m2 continuous IV infusion over 46-48 hours via elastomeric or electronic pump.
